result.summary: Preserve the explicit escaping environment before shipping: this change moves XSS protection onto a deprecated configuration path.

findings.title: Keep XSS protection independent of deprecated environment options
findings.body: The explicit Jinja environment is replaced with Starlette's deprecated **env_options path. [Starlette 0.52.1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kludex/starlette/0.52.1/starlette/templating.py) forwards autoescape=True today (lines 85–108), so this is not a current XSS bypass. However, the escaping guarantee now depends on that deprecated forwarding behavior. Dockerfile installs unbounded dependencies from pyproject.toml without uv.lock. If forwarding lapses and escaping defaults change, a movie title such as flows through search/engine.py:401–402, db.py:367, and templates/partials/search_log.html:19 into executable HTML. Removal of the keyword could instead prevent application startup.
findings.recommendation: Retain the explicitly configured jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) and pass it using Jinja2Templates(env=...).

next_steps: Restore the supported environment configuration and verify that HTML payloads in search titles remain escaped.
